It has a naturist shore and seasonal paid bathing facility; 2026 public tourism info gives June 6 to September 13 operating season with weekend hours and advises no car access near the naturbad. Planet Randy lists gay cruising but no dated present-day visitor evidence was located.

supplementary_evidence.note: Tourism guide lists 2026 seasonal bathing hours and restricted car access.

possible_aliases_or_flags: Do not confuse Bredenbeker Teich near Ahrensburg with A210 Bredenbek rest-area listing.

records.description_rewritten: Arkenberger Baggersee is a former gravel quarry lake at Berlin's northern edge near Pankow. Both gay-szene.net and Planet Randy list the wooded shore as cruising terrain, but their asserted crowd patterns are undated; an older July 2025 Planet Randy review flags poor water quality. Crucially, Berlin's official tourism page identifies a general swimming ban due to inadequate water quality, contrary to directory language about bathing.

supplementary_evidence.note: Official Berlin page identifies Arkenberger Baggerseen and expressly warns of general bathing prohibition.
Original directory lists site as cruising and notes prior water pollution.
Second gay directory gives undated description and July 2025 water quality comment.

records.access_information: Shore/woodland recreational paths may be accessible; official swimming ban stands until verified changed. Not a licensed sex area; separate public paths from quarry/depot property.
possible_aliases_or_flags: Official municipal swimming ban: do not advertise as swimming destination.
Planet Randy bathing claim conflicts with Berlin municipality.
